subject: general
question: As per the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), China emerged as the top source of international patent applications filed with it in the year 2019. Which of the following countries held this place in the year 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USA.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **In China in 2019** surpassed the US as the top source of international patent applications.
 
• **In 2018, USA was at top position. **
 
• With 58,990 applications filed in 2019 via WIPO’s Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) System, China ended the U.S. (57,840 applications in 2019) reign as the biggest user of the PCT System.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The World Intellectual Property Organization was established on** 14th July 1967.**
 
• It works under the United Nations to protect intellectual property throughout the world.
 
• It is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• The World Intellectual Property Indicators, an annual report is published by the organization covering areas of intellectual property. It was first published in 2009.
 
• As of March 2020 Francis Gurry is the Director-General. He assumed office on 1 October 2008.
 
• The United International Bureaux for the Protection of Intellectual Property is the predecessor of the World Intellectual Property Organization. It was established in 1893.
